project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: GUID of the project to import the templates into.

source_project_id.title: Source Project Id
source_project_id.description: GUID of the project to copy the templates from. Must differ from `project_id`.

node_type.title: Node Type
node_type.description: Type of the node template to import ('source', 'destination', or 'transform').

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Slug identifying the template within its node type.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Templates to copy from the source project.
